name: Kripicard Gold Tier
summary: An entry-level, virtual-only Visa/Mastercard issued by a U.S. bank, tailored for crypto holders needing instant spend access with minimal KYC requirements.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Kripicard Gold Tier charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$1.5 per month. Card issuance is US$3.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Kripicard Gold Tier?
faq.answer: It charges about 1% on non-base-currency spending.
